{{Short description|Largest libraries in the world based on number of stored items}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2020}} This sortable '''list of the world's largest libraries''' includes [[Library|libraries]] that ({{asof|2008|lc=yes}}) store 10 million or more items. All figures are based on data published by the libraries themselves.
